posts.name: Krish Patil
posts.cooked: This is honestly my first time making a post here, so please excuse me for any irregularities. I wished to know whether is it necessary to use a Linux Virtual Machine for solving the assignments and BPTs. Can I simply access and solve them from my laptop main terminal?

posts.name: aditya_nupani
posts.cooked:
You have to login to the VM in order to access the BPTs and assignments.

Have a look at: SC Course Starter

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
25f1001187:

whether is it necessary to use a Linux Virtual Machine for solving the assignments and BPTs

Solve → GAs on course portal, GrPAs on course portal and BPTs on VM.

You have to login to VM to solve BPTs. BPT 1 will be released on 20th Feb. For BPT 2-4 dates, check grading document.

How to solve them?

seek.onlinedegree.iitm.ac.in
